pages.scan: Top wide: ananya left 'Hello, Ravi. Tell me what brings you in.', ravi right silent. Middle-left: ravi 'I've been feeling tired lately.' Middle-right: caption 'Technology supports the workflow. The conversation stays human.' over a silent ananya. Bottom wide: ananya left 'We'll go through your concerns and decide the right next steps together.', ravi right silent.
pages.observation: There is no caption marking the move from reception to the consultation room; the reader only infers it from Ananya's greeting. The narration caption sits between Ravi's complaint and Ananya's reply, where her direct response to 'tired' would go. Her bottom line then answers in general terms ('your concerns'), so the tiredness is never picked up and the exchange feels cut off. 'Technology' in the caption has no visible referent in any panel. Ananya left / Ravi right is consistent in the wide panels. In the middle-right panel Ananya has no balloon, so her listening expression carries the beat.
